entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Wasm.Performance] Benchmark run never starts / driver times out in Docker; starting test 404s #64450
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #64448
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-noop, json #64447
  • CertificateManager tests don't validate Subject Alternative Name fields #64445
  • Cross middleware did not perform service registration verification #64443
  • Reporting Problem: .net core 9 blazor wasm project VS 22 throws Exception of type 'System.ExecutionEngineException' was thrown. #64441
  • .NET 10 Blazor App crashes while it works fine in .NET 9 #64440
  • Allow adding XML documents at runtime to OpenApi living inside a Nuget Package #64439
  • A reusable `_Imports.razor` or `<Using />` for Razor Components #64438
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #64437
  • Perf regression: single_query #64436
  • ValidatableType silent ignore validation for most use cases #64435
  • Improve support for multipart/form-data with complex JSON + file uploads #64429

Closed

  • Issue in converting Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebHost to Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Host #64446
  • Add loopback addresses to the development certificate SAN #64430
  • Visual Studio insiders 2026 blazor server side for .net 8 format does not work #64421
  • DefaultProblemDetailsWriter Doesn't Handle Media Type Subsets #52577
    Backlog
  • Improve startvs/startvscode scripts #64409
